query.query: SELECT s.$end_pathname AS exit_page, count() AS sessions, sum(f.intent) AS contact_sessions, sum(f.form_started) AS form_starts, sum(f.form_submitted) AS form_submits, sum(f.portfolio) AS portfolio_sessions FROM sessions s INNER JOIN (SELECT $session_id AS sid, any(person_id) AS pid, countIf(event='$pageview') AS pageviews, max(event='whatsapp_click') AS intent, max(event='form_start') AS form_started, max(event='form_submit') AS form_submitted, max(event='form_error') AS form_errors, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/servicios/%') AS service_visited, max(event='service_page_viewed') AS service_tracked, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/obras%') AS portfolio, max(event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname='/nosotros/') AS about, minIf(timestamp,event='whatsapp_click') AS contact_time, minIf(timestamp,event='$pageview' AND properties.$pathname LIKE '/obras%') AS portfolio_time FROM events WHERE timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND properties.$host IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') AND person_id NOT IN (SELECT person_id FROM cohort_people WHERE cohort_id=328910) GROUP BY sid) f ON s.id=f.sid WHERE s.$start_timestamp >= '2026-06-28 03:00:00' AND s.$start_timestamp < '2026-09-26 03:00:00' AND s.$entry_hostname IN ('vipar.com.py','www.vipar.com.py') GROUP BY exit_page ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 35
